text:
maria: Quick heads-up — final changelog sweep for v0.11.0 tomorrow at 17:00 PT. Please add one-liners to keep-a-changelog or tag your PR with `changelog-needed` if you want someone to draft it. Try to keep entries to one short sentence + a parenthetical component tag.

kai: Ack — will add mine after the final CI run.

jordan: Q: If a fix is backported to `release/v0.11`, should we add a separate backport entry or append to the original?

maria: Separate backport entry with the `backport` scope, and include PR link. Keeps the timeline clear.

sarah: I can do a formatting sweep at 16:30 PT for anything posted before cutoff. Ping me with `@sarah` if you want me to copy-edit. :white_check_mark: 

leo: Tiny nit: prefer imperative tense and avoid long descriptions. Example: `db(cache): reduce cold-start latency by 20%` rather than full paragraph.

maria: Example template (paste into the top of your PR description or keep-a-changelog):

```
- <component>(<scope>): short action phrased as imperative — brief result/impact.
  - optional: one-sentence detail or link to PR/issue
  - tags: backport, public-api, infra, perf
```

maria: Also: if your change requires a version bump in the chart or API docs, add `bump:chart` to the PR labels so release-script picks it up.

kai: I labeled #3124 with `changelog-needed` and `bump:chart`. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3124

jordan: For owners doing backports: please open the backport PR with the same one-liner and add `backport-of:#3124` in the description so we can trace it.

devex-bot: Reminder: changelog linting runs on merge. If lint fails, we'll add `changelog-fixme` and the PR will be blocked from the release branch.

leo: Is there a quick checklist we can copy to PR templates for this cycle?

maria: Yes — adding small checklist here for copy/paste:

- [ ] One-liner in keep-a-changelog (imperative, component scoped)
- [ ] PR labeled `changelog-needed` or `changelog-skip`
- [ ] Backport PR created (if applicable) with `backport` tag
- [ ] Chart/version bump labeled `bump:chart` (if applicable)

sarah: I'll run a sweep after cutoff and open quick PRs to fix formatting where trivial. If there's ambiguity I'll @-mention the PR author.

maria: Thanks — last call: drop any last-minute entries by 17:00 PT or they might miss the v0.11.0 notes. :alarm_clock:

release-bot: Release window for v0.11.0 changelog cutoff set to 2003457600. Automatic rollup will run at cutoff and post draft to the release notes channel.

kai: Got it — pushing final tiny doc change now.

jordan: Done, added backport entry and link.

sarah: Found two formatting nits, fixed them in separate PRs.

maria: Awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround, team.
